title: 第11章 有的时候不幸到了极点也是一种幸运第12章 要回半条命
content_zh:
;;
【勇敢的继承者啊，你的勇气被货郎赞赏，但这似乎并没有影响到你的幸运。】
【你看了看自己二两二的命格，也许你知道原因。】
敖鹏毫不犹豫，继续丢了五千香火进福袋。
【福袋抖了抖，掉出一件宝物。】
【这是一件破碎的青灯，也许它以前很有价值，但现在坏了。】
5000香火，继续！
【福袋抖了抖，掉出一件宝物】
【这是一柄残缺的长刀，也许它以前很有价值，但现在坏了。】
【卑鄙的继承者啊，你的幸运真是让人不忍直视，如果我是你，就应该更理智一些。】
系统开始劝了？
敖鹏眼睛一亮。
他之前就有一个猜想。
这个系统的提示音源自于旧土和现实两个巨大的意识体的糅合。
所以系统既想要玩家快点成长，又想要玩家死得快一些。
如果这句话是源自于现实世界的意识。
那么对于现实世界来说，玩家玩游戏是不会死亡的，而且还有成千上万的玩家，所以现实世界肯定希望玩家激进一点，尽快提升实力。
而自己现在冒险抽福袋，虽然个人承担了风险，但是对现实世界来说，这是一个增加强者的机会，现实世界的意识自然不会阻止。
所以会阻止自己的意识体只有一个，这是旧土世界意识体的投影。
祂在担心！

这东西有保底的几率很大！
5000香火，继续！
【福袋抖了抖，掉出一件宝物。】
【这是一件古墓出土的宝物，它虽然有用，但是带在身上会引发不幸。】
敖鹏看了看出现在手里面的东西，这是一只玉蝉一样的东西，色泽纯白，有一层淡黄色的石皮，活灵活现，一看就是极品玉雕，只不过摸起来有刺骨的阴寒。
【死蜕玉蝉】（黄级上品）
古代的时候，人们相信蝉可以从死亡之中苏醒，所以墓葬之中，死者多佩戴玉蝉。
这枚和田玉玉蝉放置在一座古墓之中，被尸气常年环绕。
佩戴效果：
死中求生，在你发生致命危险的时候，玉蝉会帮你抵挡一次攻击，抵消相应的伤害，然后破碎。
尸气诅咒，长期佩戴，你会被尸气影响，你的身体会逐渐尸化。
content_en:
;;
[Brave successor, your courage was appreciated by the salesman, but this does not seem to affect your luck. 】
[If you look at your own destiny, maybe you know the reason. 】
Ao Peng did not hesitate and continued to throw five thousand incense into the lucky bag.
[The lucky bag shook and a treasure fell out. 】
[This is a broken green lantern. Maybe it was valuable before, but it is broken now. 】
5000 incense, continue!
[The lucky bag shook and a treasure fell out]
[This is a broken long knife. Maybe it was valuable before, but now it is broken. 】
[Despicable heir, your luck is really unbearable. If I were you, I should be more sensible. 】
Has the system begun to persuade?
Ao Peng's eyes lit up.
He had a guess before.
The sound of this system comes from the fusion of two huge consciousnesses, the old earth and reality.
Therefore, the system not only wants players to grow faster, but also wants players to die faster.
If this sentence comes from the consciousness of the real world.
So for the real world, players will not die when playing games, and there are thousands of players, so the real world definitely hopes that players will be more aggressive and improve their strength as soon as possible.
And now I take the risk to draw the lucky bag. Although I have taken the risk personally, for the real world, this is an opportunity to increase the number of strong people, and the consciousness of the real world will naturally not stop it.
Therefore, there is only one consciousness that can stop oneself, and this is the projection of the consciousness of the old world.
He is worried!
There is a high chance that this thing is guaranteed!
5000 incense, continue!
[The lucky bag shook and a treasure fell out. 】
[This is a treasure unearthed from an ancient tomb. Although it is useful, carrying it with you will cause misfortune. 】
Ao Peng looked at the thing that appeared in his hand. It was something like a jade cicada. It was pure white in color and had a layer of light yellow stone skin. It was vivid. At first glance, it looked like the best jade carving, but it felt bitingly cold to the touch.
[Dead Jade Cicada] (Yellow level top grade)
In ancient times, people believed that cicadas could wake up from death, so the deceased often wore jade cicadas in tombs.
This Hotan Jade Cicada is placed in an ancient tomb and is surrounded by corpse energy all year round.
Wearing effect:
Survive in death, when you are in fatal danger, Yuchan will help you resist an attack, offset the corresponding damage, and then break into pieces.
Curse of Corpse Qi: If you wear it for a long time, you will be affected by Corpse Qi and your body will gradually transform into a corpse.
